location_description: Key Biscayne is an island town in Miami-Dade County, Florida. The population was 12,344 at the 2010 census.Key Biscayne lies south of Miami Beach and east of Miami. The village is connected to Miami via the Rickenbacker Causeway, originally built in 1947.
